title: Wait, WHEN?!
blurb: Older than you think, newer than you'd guess, and totally out of order.

cards.say: [Woolly mammoths were still alive when the Great Pyramid was built], [London had underground trains before anyone made a phone call], [the Great Wall of China is older than the Great Pyramid], and [the very first bicycles had no pedals at all].
cards.real: The oldest parts of the Great Wall date to the 600s BC, nearly 2,000 years after the Great Pyramid went up around 2560 BC.

cards.say: [Basketball was invented before the American Civil War], [sharks were swimming in the sea before there were any trees], [people flew in hot air balloons 120 years before the first airplane], and [Abraham Lincoln and Charles Darwin were born on the very same day].
cards.real: Basketball was invented in December 1891, about 26 years after the Civil War ended in 1865.

cards.say: [Nintendo started out in 1889 by selling playing cards], [Barbie had a spacesuit four years before anyone walked on the Moon], [the White House got a telephone before it got electric lights], and [the first teddy bear was sold before the first car was built].
cards.real: Teddy bears first appeared in 1902, but Karl Benz built his first car in 1886, sixteen years earlier.

cards.say: [T. rex lived closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus], [ants were crawling around before the very first dinosaurs], [giant dragonflies with wings over two feet wide lived before the dinosaurs], and [Velociraptors were about the size of a turkey].
cards.real: Ants came much later. Dinosaurs appeared about 230 million years ago, and the oldest ant fossil found so far is about 113 million years old.

cards.say: [Disney's dog Pluto got his name after the planet Pluto was discovered], [Uranus was discovered before Columbus sailed to America], [the Statue of Liberty is older than the Eiffel Tower], and [nobody used the word dinosaur until after the first photo was taken].
cards.real: Uranus was discovered in 1781, almost 300 years after Columbus first sailed to the Americas in 1492.

cards.say: [A pine tree in California sprouted before the Great Pyramid was built], [the first email was sent before the first cell phone call], [people played video games before anyone walked on the Moon], and [people walked on the Moon before color TV was invented].
cards.real: John Logie Baird showed off color TV in 1928, more than 40 years before the first Moon landing in 1969.

cards.say: [Dogs were the very first animals ever sent into space], [tortoises flew around the Moon before any astronaut did], [a chimpanzee rode a rocket into space before any American astronaut], and [when T. rex was alive, a day on Earth was shorter than 24 hours].
cards.real: Fruit flies went first, in 1947. The first dogs didn't fly until 1951.

cards.say: [Builders took nearly 200 years to finish the Leaning Tower of Pisa], [people drank chocolate for thousands of years before the first chocolate bar], [Neptune was discovered before the United States became a country in 1776], and [Queen Elizabeth I had a toilet that flushed, back in the 1590s].
cards.real: Neptune was discovered in 1846, seventy years after the United States declared independence in 1776.

cards.say: [People in Peru were munching popcorn thousands of years ago], [Hershey's chocolate bars came out before the first airplane flight], [Galileo and William Shakespeare were born in the same year], and [the very first ice skates had blades made of steel].
cards.real: The earliest known ice skates had blades made from animal bones, used about 5,000 years ago.

cards.say: [People started baking bread after they learned how to farm], [the very first computer mouse was a box made of wood], [people were playing tic-tac-toe against a computer back in 1950], and [the network that grew into the internet sent its first message in 1969].
cards.real: Bread came first. Crumbs of bread baked about 14,400 years ago were found in Jordan, thousands of years before farming began.

cards.say: [Play-Doh was sold as a wallpaper cleaner before it became a toy], [Silly Putty was invented by a scientist during World War II], [the Slinky first went on sale in toy stores in the 1980s], and [the first box of Crayola crayons, in 1903, had eight colors].
cards.real: The Slinky first went on sale in 1945, when all 400 of them sold out in about 90 minutes at a store in Philadelphia.

cards.say: [Olympic gold medals haven't been made of solid gold since 1912], [Pluto was discovered before the Wright brothers first flew, in 1903], [Princess Peach was called Princess Toadstool in English until the 1990s], and [Monopoly grew out of a game that a woman patented back in 1904].
cards.real: Pluto was found in 1930, 27 years after the Wright brothers first flew in 1903.
